name: business-model-lifecycle-auditor
description: Full lifecycle business model auditor: design (Canvas/Lean/VPC), diagnose (unit economics, retention, channels, moat, leverage), fix (pricing architecture, constraints via TOC), and test (experiments, scenarios). Produces a 15-component composite score (0-10), identifies the #1 constraint, and delivers a prioritized action plan with experiment designs. Supports SaaS, marketplace, e-commerce/DTC, agency, info products, and usage-based models.
